name: Lacunal Initiate
body:
LACUNAL INITIATE
CR 1

XP 400
LE Medium undead (android)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 11, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +2, Ref +1, Will +6

Defensive Abilities channel resistance +2, spontaneous reincarnation; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee battle staff +3 (1d6+1 B)
Ranged zero pistol +2 touch (1d8 cold, range incr. 50 ft., semi-automatic)
Special Attacks memory extraction (DC 13)
Spells Known (CL 1st, concentration +3)

0-level (at will)—daze (DC 12), detect magic, ghost sound (DC 12), telekinetic projectile
1st-level (2/day)—cause fear (DC 13), mind thrust I (DC 13)

STATISTICS

Str 12 (+1); Dex 12 (+1); Con —; Int 13 (+1); Wis 17 (+3); Cha 14 (+2)
Base Atk +1; CMB +2; CMD 13
Feats Technologist
Skills Disable Device +3, Intimidate +7, Knowledge (engineering) +3, Knowledge (religion) +6, Perception +8, Sense Motive +1
Languages Common
SQ augmented scavenger, constructed, flat affect

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Augmented Scavenger (Ex)

A lacunal android can harvest a piece of cybertech already installed into a willing or unconscious creature and integrate it into their own body. This process takes 10 minutes per point of the implantation value of the cybertech augmentation; the lacunal android can have one such augmentation at a time.

Constructed (Ex)

For the purposes of effects targeting creatures by type (such as bane weapons), a lacunal android counts both as an undead and as a construct.

Flat Affect (Ex)

Lacunal androids find emotions confusing and keep them bottled up. They take a –2 penalty to Sense Motive checks, but the DCs of Sense Motive checks attempted against them also increase by 2.

Memory Extraction (Su)

As a standard action, a lacunal android can extract memories from an adjacent creature, causing the target to become fatigued unless it succeeds at a Will saving throw.

Whether or not the creature succeeds at this saving throw, it can’t be affected by this ability again for 24 hours. This is a mindaffecting gaze attack, and the save DC is Charisma-based.

Spellcasting A lacunal android casts spells as a mystic of a level equal to its CR. It gains no other benefits of the mystic class.

Spontaneous Reincarnation (Su)

A lacunal android carries a reminder of their prior incarnation in the form of a severed head.

When a lacunal android is reduced to 0 hit points, instead of being destroyed, their consciousness is immediately transferred into this head. After 1d8 hours, the lacunal android’s body and former head awaken and can reunite to become a fully functional creature again. If all of their heads are destroyed, the lacunal android is also destroyed.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or enclave (3–4)
Treasure standard (battle staff, zero pistol, silverdisk battery [10 charges], other treasure)

While androids do not age, and could theoretically live forever, it is a fact of the universe that things fall apart—as time marches on, everything gradually moves to a state of greater entropy. Androids sense this progression of time, and realize that like other beings their place in the universe is fleeting. Usually around 100 years of age—sometimes more, sometimes less—they feel a sense of accomplishment and are ready to “reset,” allowing their mind and soul to pass into the afterlife, while their body is recycled or refurbished to serve as the shell for a new android life.

However, for some androids, just as for some members of other humanoid species, the temptation of eternal life becomes too great, and they push their physical bodies to their limits—and beyond. The obscure Cult of Lacuna is devoted to giving these androids what they seek, using occult rituals to transform them into undead creatures.

When an android first joins the Cult of Lacuna, it constructs a new techno-organic body for itself, and its consciousness is transferred into this new undead receptacle.

Its old body withers and dies, and the initiate saves the head as a trophy.

Periodically, a lacunal android must complete this ritual again, and each time, it saves the old head for its collection. It wears these heads like trophies, often wired to its body like grim animatronic novelties.
